title: Build a One-Button Game
prompt:
Build a game that's played entirely with one button — a tap, a click, or the spacebar. Nothing else.

**Entry:** Preview opens `index.html` — put everything there (inline CSS/JS, or CDN links). No Vite/npm.

Requirements:

- The whole game is controlled with a single input: tap/click anywhere, or press space (support both)
- A run can end — you can lose, crash, or finish — and the same button starts the next one
- Shows a score, distance, streak, or some other measure of how the run went
- No instructions needed — a stranger should figure it out on their first attempt

Jump, flip, stack, hover, charge, time it — one button is enough for a lot. Make it look good and feel good; people vote on these.

You're done when you can play, lose, and retry a full run in Preview using nothing but taps.
